non_claims: not a claim that indexed streamfold/zkrtp payloads are correct

research_notes.note: PCD is the proof-carrying/historical-computation shape this overlay is approaching, but this lane is transparent and local, not a SNARK.
Modern receipt designs separate public output from opaque proof material; this frontier lane preserves that separation without claiming a cryptographic seal.
Proof verification binds proof, public values, and verification key; the next real lane should name those explicitly if a zkVM path is chosen.

statement: For an extracted rev0854 overlay bundle, public verification can reconstruct and re-run the rev0853 transparent PCD checkpoint, recompute the P0 proofcore completion frontier from the carried canonical path-role map, identify streamfold sumcheck as the next narrow proof lane, and confirm publication remains blocked pending rights decisions.
